Usage: yantra browser check [options]

Run a fresh local compatibility check against the selected browser, using
isolated synthetic pages. No network: this does not look for a newer browser

Options:
  --browser <source>     browser source for this invocation (auto, managed, or
                         system)
  --browser-path <path>  absolute path to a Chrome or Chromium executable
  --json                 emit the compatibility report as JSON (default: false)
  -h, --help             display help for command
